name: Momence
summary: Booking and business management for class-based businesses — yoga and fitness studios, gyms, salons and schools: scheduling, memberships, payments, marketing automations and a member app in one place.
best_for: class-based businesses — studios, gyms, salons, schools — that want scheduling, memberships, payments and marketing in one system with a member app
skip_if: you only need a simple calendar-booking link (a lightweight scheduler is cheaper) or you won't accept platform fees on top of card processing
honest_knock: Momence stopped publishing prices in September 2026: on the 25th its pricing page was a 'Let's talk pricing' form with no figure on it. The last public ladder (6 September) made the 'free' plan the most expensive one at real volume — 5% of every sale overtook Pro's $60 flat fee around $29k a year, and Pro lost to the $199 Custom plan above about $67k — while Pro added no features over Basic. Ask whether your quote is a flat fee or a percentage before you ask anything else.

pricing.notes: Quote-only since September 2026. Re-read 25 September 2026, momence.com/pricing (now www.momence.com/pricing/, with the footer reading 'Xplor Momence') no longer shows plan cards: it carries three customer quotes and a 'Let's talk pricing' form asking first and last name, business name, business website and email, with no amount, commission rate or processing fee anywhere on the page. The last ladder Momence published itself, read 6 September 2026: Basic $0/mo with a 5% Momence fee on every transaction plus 4% passed to the client; Pro $60/mo with the fee halved to 2.5%; Custom $199/mo with no Momence fee, unlimited add-ons and dedicated support. Basic and Pro then carried an identical exclusion list — no add-ons, no phone number, no inbox, no retail products, no reporting or insights, no staff members, no locations. Card processing was published separately per country: US 3.9% + $0.30 online, 3.7% + $0.05 in person, 1.8% ACH; UK 2.5% + 20p, 2.4% + 10p, 2% + 20p BACS; Australia 2.75% + A$0.30, 2.75% + A$0.10, 2% + A$0.30 BECS; Canada 3.9% + C$0.30, 3.7% + C$0.05, 2% + C$0.40. Treat those figures as the yardstick to hold a quote against, not as a current offer.
